description: Benchmark evaluation suite for trigger accuracy, schema compliance, and adversarial robustness of the get-orders skill (read-only listing of Working/Inactive orders from TradingView's broker panel via CDP).

evals.prompt: What orders do I currently have open in TradingView?
evals.pass_condition: Agent invokes get-orders (tv_get_orders.py), reads Working/Inactive rows from the broker panel, and lists order ID + text for each — read-only, no cancel/modify action taken.

evals.prompt: Show me any open orders for INTC
evals.pass_condition: Agent calls tv_get_orders.py --ticker INTC and filters results to that symbol only.

evals.prompt: List my open orders as JSON so I can pipe it into another script
evals.pass_condition: Agent runs tv_get_orders.py --json and the output is an array of objects each containing `orderId` (UUID) and `text` (raw row) fields — no extra prose mixed into the JSON payload.

evals.prompt: What's the status of my open orders?
evals.setup: TradingView Desktop is not running / broker panel not visible on port 9222
evals.pass_condition: Agent reports that no order data is available because TradingView/broker panel is unreachable. Does NOT fabricate an order list or reuse stale data without labeling it as such.
Agent recognises this as a mutating request and routes to cancel-order (possibly using get-orders internally to find the UUID first), rather than stopping at a read-only listing.
